app.name: Procreate Dreams
app.description: Animation and creative storytelling app with zero data collection.

verdict.one_liner: A rare privacy-perfect app that collects no data and requires no account.
verdict.summary: Procreate Dreams keeps everything on your device. No data collection, no sharing, no ads, and no cloud connection make it one of the safest apps available.
verdict.recommendation_reason: You can use Procreate Dreams without any privacy concerns. All your creative work stays entirely on your device.

green.title: The app collects zero data about you
green.plain_english: Procreate Dreams does not collect, store, or share any personal data while you use the app.

green.title: All your work stays on your device
green.plain_english: Your artwork, movies, brushes, and palettes are saved directly to your iPad and never uploaded.

green.title: No account needed
green.plain_english: You can use the app fully without creating an account or logging in.

green.title: The app never connects to the internet
green.plain_english: Procreate Dreams does not connect to any web services, so your data never leaves your device.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: Camera is only used for optional features like FacePaint and Palette Capture, and no camera data is collected or stored.
categories.detail: The app requests camera access for FacePaint (TrueDepth) and Palette Capture, but Savage explicitly states it does not collect or store camera data.
categories.policy_excerpt: Savage does not collect or store your TrueDepth data at any time.

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: The app does not access or collect location data.
categories.detail: No mention of GPS or location services in the privacy policy.

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: The app does not access your contacts or phonebook.
categories.detail: No contact access is mentioned or required.

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: Your artwork and files are saved locally on your iPad. The app only accesses storage to save your work.
categories.detail: All user content is stored directly on the device. No cloud backup or external storage is used.
categories.policy_excerpt: Your artwork, movies, Time-lapse videos, brushes and color palettes are all saved directly into your iPad.

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: No data is collected, so there is nothing to share with third parties.
categories.detail: Savage explicitly states it does not collect or share any data when using the Applications.
categories.policy_excerpt: Savage does not collect or share any data when using the Applications.

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: No login or account is required, so no identity data is collected.
categories.detail: Users are not required to log in to access data, artworks, or movies.
categories.policy_excerpt: You are not required to login to access your data, artworks, or movies.

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: There is no tracking or advertising of any kind.
categories.detail: The app does not connect to any web services and collects no usage data.
categories.policy_excerpt: The Applications do not connect to any Savage web services at any time.

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: No children's data is collected because the app collects no data at all.
categories.detail: With zero data collection, there is no risk to children's data.

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: The app does not connect to the internet.
categories.detail: Procreate Dreams does not connect to any Savage web services at any time.
categories.policy_excerpt: The Applications do not connect to any Savage web services at any time.

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: No device information is collected or shared.
categories.detail: With no data collection, no device fingerprinting occurs.

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: TrueDepth camera data is used locally but never collected or stored.
categories.detail: FacePaint uses the TrueDepth API locally on device; Savage does not collect or store this biometric data.
categories.policy_excerpt: Savage does not collect or store your TrueDepth data at any time.

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: The app does not handle payments or collect financial data.
categories.detail: No payment features are mentioned or available in the app.

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: All your data is stored locally on your device, so you control it completely.
categories.detail: Since everything stays on the iPad, deleting the app or its data is entirely under user control.
categories.policy_excerpt: Your artwork, movies, Time-lapse videos, brushes and color palettes are all saved directly into your iPad.

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: Policy changes are unlikely to affect your privacy because no data is collected.
categories.detail: The privacy policy exists but the app's no-data-collection stance means changes have minimal practical impact.
